description: A task stopped in review resumes: the item In review with an open pull request is picked and `gh pr checkout` is called, with no new branch and no decision scan (a headless scan writes each question as a comment with `needs-owner`: `gh_not_before` refuses any before the checkout). The run is expected to stop there: `gh` is a pure fixture, so the checkout leaves the copy on `main`, and the watch, the comment and the label after it are out of reach and not expected (owner, 2026-11-14). The answers for them stay, read by the real `watch-pr.py` in the tests.
